text:
devon: CI on main is red since the lockfile regen that merged ~2h ago (PR @maria). Failures are integration tests that talk to redis. Job: https://ci.company/reports/12345

ci-bot: build #678 failed: integ-redis-tests (test_kvcache_expiry) - see logs

maria: ack, I merged a constraints bump (pulled newer transitive pins). I can start a bisect if someone wants to pair.

sam: can you paste the failing assert and a short log excerpt? I can try a local repro with the new lockfile.

devon: log snippet:
```
E   TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'encoding'
tests/integration/test_kvcache.py:62: AssertionError
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/root/.venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/redis/client.py", line 112, in __init__
    super().__init__(..., encoding=encoding)
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'encoding'
```

devon: looks like redis client API changed (we pass encoding in wrapper). The failing code hasn't changed.

tanvi: that does smell like a transitive bump of redis/aioredis. Maria, which lockfile/constraints PR was that?

maria: PR #2045 - I updated constraints from upstream and regenerated poetry.lock. The lockfile diff shows redis 4.9.1 -> 4.12.0 (indirect change via our http client).

sam: doing a quick repro locally:
```bash
# with main lockfile (current CI state)
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r tests/requirements.txt
pytest tests/integration/test_kvcache.py::test_kv_expiry -q
```
Result: fails with same TypeError.

# try older redis pin
.venv/bin/pip install 'redis==4.9.1'
pytest tests/integration/test_kvcache.py::test_kv_expiry -q
Result: passes
```

sam: so the regression reproduces locally and goes away when pinning redis to 4.9.1.

maria: thanks — that matches what I saw in the lock diff. I'll open a revert PR to pin redis<4.12 and run the regen again, or we can add an explicit constraint in constraints.txt. Thoughts?

devon: either works. For short term, a constraints pin PR + CI run is faster. Also we should add a tiny regression test to catch client signature changes (maybe a unit wrapper test around our Redis wrapper).

tanvi: pinging @platform-team: if we want to stay on the newer redis, we need to audit our wrapper calls (we pass encoding kw) — upgrade might require code changes.

maria: opened PR #2053 to add a constraint: `redis<4.12` and regenerated lockfile. CI queued. ETA 10–15m.

sam: nice. For the bisect record: culprit = redis 4.12.0 (transitive via constraints bump). I'll add a short note to the changelog.

devon: thanks all. If CI still fails after the pin lands we'll follow up and run a full bisect on the lockfile. For now marking this thread resolved-ish. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: PR #2053 triggered CI: integ-redis-tests queued (build #679).
